structure: Part 6, consignment addresses: the 7 traces of consignment-parties.fit.spec.js › consignment addresses, every one opened and its full action list read. (1) cattle: five roles plus the CPH number (81 actions; roles page asserted at actions 37-62); (2) cat: permanent address replaces the CPH number (64 actions; roles page at 36-49, then a direct GET of /cph-number redirected to the roles page); (3) picking an address for every role, then the CPH number (208 actions, the core trace: each of the five pickers at actions 39-108, the place of origin country-search label at 109-111, choosing an address per role at 113-143, the CPH page at 145-162, a partial CPH at 164-171, a full CPH at 173-191, continue to the contact address at 193-195); (4) same as place of origin / same as consignee shortcuts (83 actions; roles page with shortcuts at 54, after applying them at 67); (5) the address search on a picker filters the list (61 actions; consignor picker filtered by 'Nordic' at 41-45); (6) a picker continued with nothing chosen returns to the roles page unchanged (55 actions; the importer picker at 38-42); (7) save and return to hub from a picker (55 actions; the consignee picker to the hub at 38-42). Every trace starts the same way (live animals, origin France, one species, Internal market / Breeding, a number of animals), then navigates straight to /design-release-2.1/roles-and-addresses; those earlier pages belong to other parts. Pages in this slice, in journey order: the Consignment addresses (roles) page /roles-and-addresses (always; six sections: Place of origin, Consignor, Consignee, Importer, Place of destination, then County parish holding (CPH) number for cattle or Permanent address for cats), five role pickers /place-of-origin, /consignor-or-exporter, /consignee, /importer and /place-of-destination (each reached from its 'Add a ...' or 'Change' link), and the CPH number page /cph-number (cattle only; redirected for a cat). Conditional surface: the CPH or permanent-address section by species; 'Same as place of origin' on the consignor and 'Same as consignee' on the importer and place of destination only when the source role is filled and the target empty; an inset address block and a 'Change' link once a role is filled; the place of origin picker's country search in place of the free-text search. The notification hub (reached by 'Save and return to hub') and the contact address page (reached by 'Save and continue' on a complete roles page) are other parts' pages and are claimed here only for the transitions. The add-address pages, the contact address and the permanent-address pages are part 7. Network logs read for every trace: only server-rendered document requests (GET 200, POST 302) and a local live-reload socket; no data call to any other system. Snapshots taken on the roles page (empty, with shortcuts, after shortcuts, complete, cat), on each picker, on the filtered consignor picker, on the CPH page and on the hub after a picker's save and return.
